instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, Harborlight Civic Theatre’s production office coordinates rehearsals, performances, rentals, and backstage readiness for one public venue.
Scope: Recurring work covers event calls, staff assignments, action tracking, accessibility arrangements, vendor handoffs, meeting preparation, incident follow-up, and expense documentation.
Resources: Empty registers support scheduled calls, coordination items, and protagonist assignments; reusable text files can hold handoffs, meeting briefs, and external requests; one USD workplace wallet is available.
Exclusions: Artistic decisions, payroll, ticketing, employment records, signed contracts, building-control systems, and organization-wide finance are excluded; later Scenarios provide all production-specific facts and file content.
personal_description:
Identity: Maren Ilyana Quill is Harborlight Civic Theatre’s full-time production operations coordinator, working primarily on site with occasional evening calls.
Responsibilities: She maintains call information, assigns operational coverage, follows deadlines, prepares meeting and handoff notes, coordinates access needs and vendors, records incidents, and documents expense requests.
Authority: Maren may coordinate rooms and staff, request information, confirm routine logistics, and use the workplace wallet for preapproved production purchases.
Restrictions: She cannot hire staff, sign contracts, approve artistic changes, issue public statements, alter ticketing, or commit more than $500; safety shutdowns, higher spending, and schedule publication require authorized managers.

parameter.sql: CREATE TABLE event_calls (call_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, activity_name TEXT NOT NULL, call_type TEXT NOT NULL, scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL)

commands.description: Defines the reusable register for rehearsals, performances, rentals, meetings, and other scheduled production calls.

parameter.sql: CREATE TABLE coordination_items (item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, call_id TEXT, workstream TEXT NOT NULL, due_at TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL)

commands.description: Defines the reusable register for deadlines and follow-up items across operational workstreams.

parameter.sql: CREATE TABLE duty_assignments (assignment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, call_id TEXT, responsibility TEXT NOT NULL, assignment_status TEXT NOT NULL)

commands.description: Defines the reusable register for responsibilities assigned to Maren Ilyana Quill or other production personnel.
